title: Coherent finite reduction model for completed coefficient extension
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E\subset L\subset\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ with valuation rings $\mathcal O_E\subset\mathcal O_L$ and uniformizers $\varpi_E,\varpi_L$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme $W$ on which $\ell$ is invertible. On $W_{\mathrm{proet}}$ put $A_m=(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^m)_W$, $B_m=(\mathcal O_L/\varpi_L^m)_W$, $R_E=\varprojlim A_m$, and $R_L=\varprojlim B_m$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. The coefficient maps $A_m\to B_m$ and $R_E\to B_m$ are those of [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension], with actual quotient transitions. For $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(R_E))$ let $K_m=K\otimes^L_{R_E}A_m$ and let $S_{E,L}K$ be the completed scalar extension of that definition, computed on one flat-term K-flat representative $P$ by $R\lim_m\operatorname{Res}^L_m(P\otimes_{R_E}B_m)$ [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

The system $C_{E,L}(K)_m=K_m\otimes^L_{A_m}B_m$, with transitions from the actual quotient maps, is normalized [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]. There is a natural isomorphism of coherent derived $B_\bullet$-systems
$$\mathcal R_L(S_{E,L}K)\xrightarrow{\sim}C_{E,L}(K),$$
where $\mathcal R_L$ is derived reduction with its coherent quotient transitions [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. This map is the coherent counit [lem-coef-normalized-dvr-effectivity] for the normalized system represented by $(P\otimes_{R_E}B_m)_m$, followed by the inverse of the simultaneous scalar-association isomorphisms
$$(P\otimes_{R_E}A_m)\otimes_{A_m}B_m\xrightarrow{\sim}P\otimes_{R_E}B_m,\quad(x\otimes a)\otimes b\longmapsto x\otimes ab.$$
It is independent of the representative through the canonical resolution comparisons and is compatible with every transition $B_m\to B_n$. For $L=E$ it is the usual reduction counit. For $E\subset L\subset F$ the same comparisons agree under successive extension with the comparison for $E\subset F$, using the scalar-association maps, as an identity of coherent quotient-system comparisons. No unramifiedness, flatness of $A_m\to B_m$, boundedness or constructibility of $K$ is assumed.

split_report.summary: Preserved the complete statement. No new nodes and no new finiteness or unramifiedness hypothesis.
split_report.blueprint: Serves the natural Weil isomorphism and coefficient-extension compatibility in def-weil-frobenius-coefficient-twists, via former step 6 of lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso: actual finite quotient models (steps 1--3), reduction comparison (steps 4--5), and identity/successive-extension coherence (steps 6--8).

tool_uses.why: Coherent counit for an arbitrary normalized DVR quotient tower; the purity-conventions unit has no effectivity theorem.
Functorial derived inverse limit of a coherent strict tower; used to apply the limit to the successive-extension system isomorphism, not to replace a purity argument.
Generic bilinear sheafification interface for the explicit scalar-association maps; the unit has no such module-sheaf interface.
Equivalence between the localization of flat-term K-flat models and the derived category, used to descend naturality from chain maps to arbitrary derived morphisms.

Simultaneous derived coefficient extension acts on coherent semilinear systems and their morphisms without flat quotient-map assumptions; needed to extend the coherent counit, rather than only its evaluated maps.
The actual reduction/total-limit adjunction and counit naturality in the derived system category; needed for an identity of coherent system comparisons, not just their evaluations.

Existence of a flat-term K-flat resolution (Stacks 06YS) on the ringed pro-etale site; generic resolution tool of sk-thm-picard-semicon, which sk-def-purity-conv and sk-def-sf-operations do not restate.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q72-2f99060fb (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item, all 8 steps and the full statements of the 25 cited nodes. Sources checked: the blueprint main-20261015 def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom integral clause (no explicit comparison there, so by: agent is right); the lem-coef-normalized-dvr-effectivity statement and proof (it uses only a uniformizer of the DVR, so it applies with L in place of E and to unbounded K); and Stacks sites-cohomology 0G7E (line 3508) and 06YY (line 3585), which need no flatness of the coefficient map. Steps 1-3: quotient models are flat-term K-flat by 0G7E; the association maps (x⊗a)⊗b↦x⊗ι(a)b and their inverses are well defined by balancing and form a strict quotient-system isomorphism; the normalization comparison, its adjoint and the cocycle are verified. Step 4 is phi=a^{-1}e_D. It identifies the definition's cone model with the total Rlim through the 'each value is a derived limit' clause of the well-definedness lemma and the Roos-triangle tower lemma; this is a standard glossed comparison, accepted. Step 5: naturality descends through the equivalence of localized flat-term K-flat complexes with D(R_E). Step 6: for L=E it is the unitor, giving the reduction counit of the completion. Steps 7-8: the identity h e_H = e_J R_F L_F(h) holds by counit naturality; substituting phi_{E,L}, phi_{L,F} and phi_{E,F} gives the successive-extension clause, and both four-factor rebracketings agree. Small cases tested: K=0, K=R_E, L=E, m=n, unbounded K, empty W, and the non-flat ramified map Z/l^2 -> F_l[x]/x^2. The statement is true and not weakened. No new nodes; no duplicate in the DAG or the blueprint (checked against lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension, lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition, lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison and lem-coef-integral-finite-extension); no cycle; no SGA.
